title: Sonata No. 2 for unaccompanied violin
video_use_ideas: The middle movement for a swaying, thoughtful cut.
legal_notes: Mutopia legal.html says the contributor dedicated this edition to the public domain (print, sell, change, distribute, record, perform). The LilyPond header copyright/license line is "Public Domain". Composition is PD-EU (life+70) and PD-US (published before 1930). Mutopia piece 1522. Typesetter: Carl M. Bolstad. The composer line in sonate2.ly says Op. 42, Heft 1 No. 2, and the title is Sonata 2. The mutopiaopus field in the same file says "42, Heft 1 No. 1", which disagrees; this file is Sonata 2. First movement is marked Allegro con grazia. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
credit_text:
